items.author: aisha.b
items.title: Room-temperature stable lyophilized BRT-7 formulation
items.body: Goal: a freeze-dried formulation of our BRT-7 reverse transcriptase that keeps at least 90% activity after 12 months at 25 C, so kits can ship without cold chain. Uncertainty: no published excipient system we know of keeps this enzyme class above 90% at 25 C; trehalose alone is the textbook answer and our early tests suggest it is not enough. Accelerated model: 8 weeks at 37 C as a predictor of 12 months at 25 C.

items.author: tran.q
items.title: Stability run 1: trehalose 5% baseline
items.body: Hypothesis: 5% trehalose alone keeps activity above 90% after 8 weeks at 37 C.

items.author: tran.q
items.body: 8 week result at 37 C: 72% residual activity (n=3). Hypothesis rejected.

items.author: aisha.b
items.title: Stability run 2: sucrose + dextran matrix
items.body: Hypothesis: a sucrose and dextran 40 matrix with a higher glass transition protects the enzyme better than trehalose.

items.author: aisha.b
items.body: 8 week result: 81% residual activity. Better, still below target. Moisture content 2.8%, which may be too high.

items.author: omid.f
items.title: Freeze-drying cycle: cake collapse investigation
items.body: Run 3 cakes collapsed during primary drying at -25 C shelf temperature. Determine collapse temperature of the new matrix.

items.author: omid.f
items.body: Freeze-dry microscopy: collapse at -29 C. Lowered primary drying shelf temperature to -32 C. Cakes are now elegant, residual moisture 1.1%.

items.author: aisha.b
items.title: Stability run 3: trehalose + arginine + pullulan
items.body: Hypothesis: adding 50 mM arginine to suppress aggregation and 2% pullulan as a glass former keeps activity above 90%, using the corrected -32 C cycle.

items.author: aisha.b
items.body: 8 week result at 37 C: 94% residual activity (n=3, range 92 to 95%). Meets the accelerated target. Real-time 25 C study started, 12 month read-out due April 2027.

items.author: marc.d
items.body: Good. Note that the 8 week / 37 C model is our own assumption; we should confirm against the real-time data at 3 and 6 months.

items.author: tran.q
items.title: Real-time stability: 3 month read-out
items.body: Measure activity after 3 months at 25 C for run 3 formulation.

items.author: tran.q
items.body: 3 month at 25 C: 97% residual activity. Consistent with the accelerated prediction so far.

items.author: sofia.r
items.title: Miniaturize BRT-7 activity assay from 96-well to 384-well
items.body: Customers want to run more samples per plate. Uncertainty: whether the fluorescence signal-to-noise holds at 10 uL volumes, where evaporation and meniscus effects are larger.

items.author: sofia.r
items.title: Pilot: 384-well at 10 uL
items.body: Hypothesis: straight scale-down keeps Z' above 0.5.

items.author: sofia.r
items.body: Z' fell from 0.78 in 96-well to 0.41 at 10 uL. Strong edge effects in the outer wells.

items.author: eli.m
items.title: Edge effect mitigation
items.body: Try foil seal and 12 uL volume with higher substrate concentration.

items.author: sofia.r
items.body: With foil seal and 12 uL: Z' 0.62. Usable, not yet validated across lots.
